items.title: Why looking at field goal attempt differential is misleading
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
Why looking at field goal attempt differential is misleading

It does not take into account free throws. The Raptors foul more than any other team. Because of this, Raptors opponents are taking less field goal attempts and more free throw attempts

TOR also has below average offense free throw rate
